text:
maya: heads up — we're getting an uptick of 502/504s from hosted inference in us-west-2. Customers reporting timeouts from the api.redwood.com/chat endpoint. Kicking off war room.

rajat: seeing lots of `upstream timed out` in the gateway logs, and a simultaneous spike in p50 token latency. Not sure if it's model-side or gateway/backpressure.

connor: customer ticket IDs: #4521, #4524 — multiple customers say requests hang ~10-15s then 504. They repro with small payloads.

ops-sam: I'm on it. First mitigation — enabling fallback routing to smaller model variant for requests older than t-1. Doing now.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: route-fallback-rollout to 10% canary by ops-sam — started.

ava: our app saw a 20% error rate spike on SDK calls starting ~12:48 UTC. Happy to share sample request if helpful: `{\"input\":\"generate short summary\",\"max_tokens\":64}`

rajat: pulling front proxy metrics — connection pooled sockets exhausted on gateway pods. There's a leak in keepalive handling after last night's proxy config change. Suspect `keepalive_timeout` lowered incorrectly.

maya: timeline — config change rolled at 02:10 PT (last night), error spike at 05:48 PT. Could be correlated.

connor: repro steps from customer:
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}], "max_tokens":64}'
2) start timer -> response hangs -> 504 after ~12s

rajat: captured gateway log snippet: 
```
2026-08-02T05:50:12Z gateway-1 ERROR upstream timed out (dial tcp 10.10.45.22:443: i/o timeout)
2026-08-02T05:50:12Z gateway-1 WARN connection pool exhausted (active:1024 max:1024)
```
ops-sam: immediate mitigation done: 1) roll back proxy keepalive change to previous value; 2) increase gateway pod replicas from 6 -> 12; 3) enable fallback routing fully to smaller model. Will monitor.

maya: good. Can we also open a short-lived circuit breaker for requests to the heavy model if queue depth > 800? That will protect model infra.

rajat: adding CB rule now. Patch applied to routing policy: `if queue_depth > 800 -> route small-quant model` and `if queue_depth > 1200 -> 429`.

connor: sending customers the temporary remediation steps and ETA: 30m for stabilization. Ava, please confirm if this reduces your error rate.

ava: confirming — errors dropped to ~2% after 12:05 UTC, huge improvement. Thanks.

maya: postmortem notes (initial): root cause likely misconfigured proxy keepalive that accelerated socket churn and exhausted gateway connection pool under bursty load -> upstream timeouts -> 504/502 surface to customers. Contributing factors: no preflight load test for keepalive change, model request queuing lacks early circuit breaker for certain endpoints.

elena: adding product impact notes — several PLG customers affected, some churn risk. Need comms draft.

ops-sam: immediate action items (owner, due):
- ops-sam: revert proxy change permanently and add config validation test (due: +1d)
- rajat: add automated circuit-breaker + threshold alerting and backlog sensor (due: +2d)
- maya: add chaos/load test for keepalive variants in staging (due: +4d)
- connor: follow up with impacted customers w/ timeline and mitigation summary (due: +24h)
- elena: customer comms + postmortem draft (due: +48h)

maya: created an incident ticket `INC-17895` and linked thread. We'll run a full postmortem after 72h monitoring window.

rajat: logs to attach for PM: gateway connection metrics, proxy config diff, model queue depth histograms, and relevant pod restarts. I'll push to the incident doc.

connor: closing war room in 30m if metrics remain stable. Leaving thread for follow-up action items. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks all. Quick checklist for postmortem: timeline, root cause, why detection lagged, remediation, action items, regression test plan. Assigning leads above.

deploy-bot: deploy success: route-fallback-rollout -> 100% complete.

ops-sam: marking incident as stabilized at 06:10 UTC. last observed elevated error rate ~06:05 UTC.

maya: end of thread — will drop PM link here when ready.
